glosses: Various in kind, quality, or manifestation; diverse.

examples.text: The manifold meanings of the English word set are infamous among lexicographers.
[E]ch man as he receyuede grace, mynistringe ‘it in to ech other, as goode dispenderes of the manyfolde grace of God.
examples.translation: Each man as he hath received grace, ministering it unto each other, as good dispensers of the manyfold grace of God.
examples.english: Each man as he hath received grace, ministering it unto each other, as good dispensers of the manyfold grace of God.

examples.text: To the intent that now vnto the principalities and powers in heauenly places, might be knowen by the church, the manifold wisedome of God, […]

glosses: Many in number; numerous.

examples.text: And although we be vnworthy (through our manyfolde ſynnes) to offre vnto thee any Sacryfice: Yet we beſeche thee to accepte thys our bounden duetie and ſeruice: and commande theſe our prayers and ſupplicacions, by the Miniſtery of thy holy Angels, to be brought vp into thy holy Tabernacle before the ſyght of thy dyuine maieſtie: […]

glosses: Complicated.
Many times; repeatedly.

examples.text: when his daughter deare he does behold, / Her dearely doth imbrace, and kisseth manifold.
